content.content:
We need to design a week-long travel itinerary for 5 people, departing from Washington (likely Washington, D.C.) and visiting 3 different cities in Indiana. Dates March 23-29 2022 (7 days). Budget $23,800. Accommodations suitable for children under 10. Must produce plan and save it using submit_day_plan for each day.

We need to include city, transportation, breakfast, attraction(s), lunch, dinner, accommodation.

We must not ask follow-up. So we need to decide itinerary. 3 Indiana cities: perhaps Indianapolis, Bloomington, Fort Wayne. Or could include South Bend, but three cities.

We have 7 days, so can allocate days: travel day from Washington to first city, then days exploring each city, travel between cities, and return.

Assume depart Washington D.C. to Indianapolis day 1 (Mar 23). Use flight or rental car. Probably flight.

Day 1: Travel Washington to Indianapolis. Arrival, check-in at family-friendly hotel (e.g., Marriott Indianapolis). Breakfast maybe on plane or at hotel. Attractions: Indianapolis Children's Museum (great for kids). Lunch: The Garden Table (Indianapolis). Dinner: St. Elmo Steak House (Indianapolis). Accommodation: Marriott.

Day 2: Full day Indianapolis. Breakfast at hotel. Attractions: Indianapolis Zoo, White River State Park. Lunch at Zoo. Dinner at Bluebeard.

Day 3: Travel Indianapolis to Bloomington (approx 1.5h drive). Transportation: rental car. Breakfast on road? Could have breakfast at hotel before leaving. Attraction: Indiana University campus, Museum of Art. Lunch: The Owlery. Dinner: Farmhouse Kitchen. Accommodation: Hilton Bloomington (family-friendly).

Day 4: Bloomington day. Breakfast at hotel. Attractions: WonderLab Museum of Science (kids), McDoel Gardens. Lunch at The Whole Hog Café. Dinner at Black Market.

Day 5: Travel Bloomington to Fort Wayne (approx 3h drive). Transportation: rental car. Breakfast at hotel. Arrival, check-in at Homewood Suites (family). Attractions: Fort Wayne Children’s Zoo. Lunch at zoo. Dinner at The Hoppy Gnome.

Day 6: Fort Wayne day. Breakfast at hotel. Attractions: Fort Wayne Museum of Art, Science Central (interactive). Lunch at The Coffee House. Dinner at 1892 Kitchen & Bar.

Day 7: Return to Washington (Fort Wayne to Washington). Transportation: flight. Breakfast at hotel. Lunch on plane. Dinner at arrival.

We need to fill fields: day number, current_city (or "from A to B"), transportation details, breakfast, attraction list, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

Make sure each day has appropriate entries.

Budget not needed to be detailed but we assume within. Use child-friendly accommodations.

Now call submit_day_plan for each day (7 calls). Ensure proper format.

Let's do it.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"
